Short title and commencement

ACT VIII OF 2005
ACT VIII OF 2005
Export Development
Fund (Amendment) Act 2005
An Act to
amend the Export Development Fund Act, 1999
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 6th July, 2005]
It is hereby enacted as follows:-‑
1. Short title and
commencement.---(1) This Act
may be called the Export. Development Fund (Amendment) Act, 2005.
(2) it shall come into force at
once.

Amendment of section 3, Act VI of 1999

ACT VIII OF 2005
ACT VIII OF 2005
Export Development
Fund (Amendment) Act 2005
An Act to
amend the Export Development Fund Act, 1999
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 6th July, 2005]
It is hereby enacted as follows:-‑
2. Amendment of section 3, Act
VI of 1999.---In the Export
Development Fund Act, 1999 (VI of 1999), in section 3,--‑
(a) in subsection (2), after
clause (i), the following new clause shall be inserted, namely:
"(ia) the whole receipts of
the Export Development Surcharge collected by the Federal Government;";
and
(b) after subsection (2) amended
as aforesaid, the following new subsection shall be inserted, namely:--‑
"(2A) For the purposes of
clause (ia) of subsection (2), in each year's budget estimates, the Ministry of
Finance shall. propose to the Parliament an appropriation equivalent to the
receipts of the Export Development Surcharge collected during the preceding
year which shall be transferred to the Fund after the approval of budget
estimates for the year.".
